enforced_by: the video teardown's doctrine read (the emotional map); recorded as unknown, never refused
note: The shape of a piece's feeling, start to end.

rows.name: Dip and rise
rows.what: Fall into the problem, climb out with the product. The commonest shape in direct response.

extra.shape: recognition → frustration or unease (the low) → turn → relief or satisfaction → desire

rows.name: Steady climb
rows.what: No low: each beat raises the feeling a step until the close.

rows.name: Set-up and reveal
rows.what: A normal moment broken by something unexpected; the reveal is the peak.

extra.shape: calm or recognition → surprise (the turn) → amusement or satisfaction

rows.name: Held warmth
rows.what: No problem and no turn; the piece stays in the viewer's world and lets them feel at home in it.

rows.name: Contrast
rows.what: Two feelings cut against each other; the side the piece ends on wins.

extra.shape: frustration (them) ↔ satisfaction (us), alternating, ending on us
